claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: PCI-34051 is a highly HDAC8-selective inhibitor that induces caspase-dependent apoptosis only in T-cell lymphoma/leukemia lines via a PLCgamma1- and calcium-dependent mechanism, with no histone or tubulin acetylation; at 2.5 uM it should kill only a small subset of hematopoietic lines, and its recently described off-target inhibition of leucine aminopeptidase 3 is unlikely to be broadly cytotoxic.
